OUSD's own Black Thriving Institute 2023 page (Office of Equity racial justice taskforce) lists a facilitator from Wright Community Services, matching the agenda contract with the Office of Equity
research.notes: Oakland location not confirmed on any fetched page (site shows only 'California'); no CA Secretary of State or SAM.gov record found. Identity rests on exact name plus the OUSD Office of Equity event listing.

profile.summary: A company that works to empower system-involved families through awareness and education. It runs a Family Learning Education Center with parenting and domestic violence classes, and a Monitored Visiting Program for court-ordered visits and safe exchanges. It also offers consultation, training and facilitation for agencies that serve these communities.
